sentences.en: The soil in this area is very tillable, so we can grow corn here.
sentences.zh: 这片地区的土壤非常适合耕种，所以我们可以在那里种玉米。

sentences.en: Some of the land on our farm isn't tillable due to its rocky nature.
sentences.zh: 由于地势太崎岖，我们农场的一些土地不适合耕种。

sentences.en: They are planning to turn this barren land into productive, tillable farmland.
sentences.zh: 他们计划把这块荒地改造成可以耕作的肥沃农田。

senses.zh: 适宜耕种的， 可耕种的
